plan.policy: Fixed row/column/mixed second-order contrasts excluding centre, correct variance weights, nominal Gaussian union bound across588 local tests; no fitted threshold or learned-weight change.

protection.mixed_contrast: TL+BR-TR-BL; variance=sum of four corner variances; affine-null and diagonal-sensitive.

limits: Consulted development controls; independent noisy confirmation remains required.
Estimated Gaussian contrast scale is a heuristic, not a calibrated edge probability.
Protection may reduce denoising and fail on weak structures; all original gates retained.
